name: Brixa Studio
description:
Brixa Studio turns your brand into living templates that any AI assistant can fill, resize, and render — straight from the chat.

Import the designs you already have (Claude Design, Figma, Canva or your own files) and Brixa makes them reusable: your colors, fonts, logo and photos become brand tokens; the parts that change (headline, photo, price) become slots. From then on, producing a piece is one sentence: "make the August promo with this photo" — and out comes a finished, on-brand PNG or PDF, rendered server-side with a real layout engine.

What you can do:
- Onboard in minutes: bring your website or a PDF and get a starter kit of templates designed around your identity.
- Generate social posts, stories, price lists, menus with QR codes, certificates, email headers and printable A4/A5 documents.
- Turn your footage into on-brand video: composite a branded card over your own clip, or stitch a carousel into a reel — rendered server-side.
- Auto-resize any design to sibling formats (story → square post) in one call.
- Keep every piece on brand: contrast checks, brand-token inheritance and a design review tool (describe) built in.
- Share templates and finished pieces to a public gallery, or keep them private per project with role-based access and admin approval.

Brixa Studio is MCP-native: the assistant is the design tool. No canvas to learn, no drag and drop — you talk, your brand ships.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Brixa Studio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Brixa Studio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.brixastudio.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Brixa Studio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brixa Studio lists 54 MCP tools, including adopt_model, compose_reel, compose_video, confirm_photo_upload, create_project, delete_data_rule, delete_font, delete_model, delete_photo, delete_pieces, delete_project, and derive_model.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Brixa Studio?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Brixa Studio in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Brixa Studio MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brixa Studio requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Brixa Studio is developed by Brixa. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
